scope: Three original static Spend Network reward-art candidates for existing Fracture Lines roles. No runtime, descriptor, registry, saved/earned binding, production-count or release adoption.
rightsScope: New AI-generated originals made for this project from independent text prompts. No reference image, existing game image or named artist style was supplied. These are fictional cooperation and resource-sharing scenes, not Coupa product screens, approved mascots, endorsements, financial or AI performance claims, historical reconstructions or exclusive-rights certification.
generation: Three independent text-only generate calls; no retries, edit calls, reference uploads, crop, stretch, resampling, re-encoding or derivative images. Default tool files remain untouched; workspace copies are byte-identical.

review.agent: All three actual default/copy PNGs inspected with native image tools. Scene observations and visible prompt deviations are recorded per image.
review.root: Independent root visual acceptance is a separate cache receipt; no approval is inferred from these source checks.

observations.scene: A cobalt-walled ring of repair workshops surrounds a tree and shared worktable; plain blue reusable crates, a handcart and four scenic openings make the resource-sharing story visible.
observations.topologyEcho: The enclosing ring and gateways echo Split Ring without reproducing its authored collision walls.
observations.deviations: People around the table and near gate are larger than requested. The result is brighter and warmer than the cool-morning brief, with an invented waterfront town, bell and incidental churchlike towers in the distance. These are not a named place or corporate campus.
observations.style: Blue brick and crates, amber workshop interiors, copper and greenery provide the established Spend Network palette through physical materials.

observations.scene: Three separately roofed supply bays step beside a sheltered passage: receiving crates, checking and repairing household fittings, and returning useful items. A bright orchard and distant water open the right side.
observations.topologyEcho: Deep bays connect to one shared path, loosely echoing Fault Fan. Their result is a stepped linear arrangement rather than an exact branching-spine blueprint.
observations.deviations: The near people are larger than requested. The scene is sunny and locally mountainous, with distant water and a small settlement beyond the intended inland orchard. All geography and activity are fictional; no procurement-process accuracy is claimed.
observations.style: Marine-blue roof ribs and shutters, pale concrete, copper gutters and soft green landscape under clear post-rain light.

observations.scene: Three main river islands hold a repair workshop, glass greenhouse and shared depot at blue hour; two neighbors carry a blue crate across a patched causeway while warm lamps reflect in dark water.
observations.topologyEcho: Separated workshop islands and replacement spans echo Frayed Causeway. Small causeway piers are scenery, not additional missions or collision geometry.
observations.deviations: The carrying figures are larger than the requested tiny silhouettes. No connecting bridge to the middle greenhouse is clearly visible, so the picture does not establish a complete connected network. The main workshop is strongly timber-clad rather than the requested brick-and-timber mix.
observations.style: Navy and cobalt water and sky, muted teal reeds and amber interiors form a dark final reward with broad readable island silhouettes.

conceptualBasis: The existing Spend Network source guides informed blue/cyan/amber material vocabulary and fictional shared-resource themes. Earlier parent-selected article links remain in those guides; this batch did not retrieve those pages or derive factual or financial assertions from them.
